description: This file defines the ModuleScanner class used for analyzing module packages in a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment. It performs security checks, scans directories and files for potentially unsafe code, and analyzes manifest files to prevent overriding core files or executing malicious code.

classes.name: ModuleScanner
classes.description: A class for scanning module package files, analyzing PHP code safety, validating extensions, and checking for potential security issues within SuiteCRM/SugarCRM package files.

methods.name: printToWiki
methods.description: Prints default extensions and blacklisted functions for Wiki documentation.

methods.name: getIssues
methods.description: Returns the list of issues found during scanning.

methods.name: hasIssues
methods.description: Returns true if any issues have been detected; otherwise, false.

methods.name: isValidExtension
methods.description: Checks if a file has a valid extension based on predefined list.

methods.name: isConfigFile
methods.description: Determines if a given file is a core configuration file.

methods.name: scanDir
methods.description: Recursively scans a directory for files and performs security analysis.

methods.name: isPHPFile
methods.description: Checks if file contents contain PHP code tags.

methods.name: scanFile
methods.description: Reads and analyzes a single file, checking for potentially dangerous PHP code or functions.

methods.name: sugarFileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists within the SugarCRM files.md5 checksum list, indicating it is an core SugarCRM file.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Sanitizes a file path to prevent directory traversal issues.

methods.name: scanManifest
methods.description: Scans a manifest file for disabled actions and file overrides, and checks for malicious code.

methods.name: scanCopy
methods.description: Inspects if copying or overriding core files is unsafe or unauthorized.

methods.name: scanPackage
methods.description: Main entry point for scanning a package directory, including its manifest and files.

methods.name: displayIssues
methods.description: Displays accumulated issues in a human-readable format.

methods.name: getIssuesLog
methods.description: Generates a log string of issues found.

methods.name: lockConfig
methods.description: Saves the current configuration state hash to detect changes.

methods.name: checkConfig
methods.description: Detects if configuration was modified since last check, raising an issue if so.
